pokedexEntries.ru: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout BELDUM’s body. This POKéMON communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.

pokedexEntries.sa: BELDUM keeps itself floating by generating a magnetic force that repels earth’s natural magnetism. When it sleeps, this POKéMON anchors itself to a cliff using the hooks on its rear.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It uses magnetic waves to converse with its kind. All the cells in its body are magnetic.

pokedexEntries.em: When BELDUM gather in a swarm, they move in perfect unison as if they were but one POKéMON. They communicate with each other using brain waves.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

pokedexEntries.hgss: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground’s natural magnetism, letting it float.

pokedexEntries.bw: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Its cells are all magnetic, and it communicates with others by using magnetic pulses.

pokedexEntries.x: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground’s natural magnetism, letting it float.

pokedexEntries.y: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

pokedexEntries.or: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout Beldum’s body. This Pokémon communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.

pokedexEntries.as: Beldum keeps itself floating by generating a magnetic force that repels earth’s natural magnetism. When it sleeps, this Pokémon anchors itself to a cliff using the hooks on its rear.

pokedexEntries.su: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.

pokedexEntries.mo: With magnetic traction, it pulls its opponents in close. When they’re in range, it slashes them with its rear claws.

pokedexEntries.us: Instead of blood, magnetism flows through its body. When it’s feeling bad, try giving it a magnet.

pokedexEntries.um: If you anger it, it will do more than rampage. It will also burst out strong magnetism, causing nearby machines to break.

pokedexEntries.sw: From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force that rapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered on Beldum’s sharp claws.

pokedexEntries.sh: The cells in this Pokémon’s body are composed of magnetic material. Instead of blood, magnetic forces flow through Beldum’s body.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: They converse with one another by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.
